questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' in the 13/14 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Cara le Roux holds it, with a total of 9.

questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 5 wickets in a match double more times, Robyn Searle or Dané van Niekerk?
questions.explanation: Robyn Searle: 1 times. Dané van Niekerk: 2 times.

questions.question: How many wickets separate the all-time #1 (Michelle du Preez) and #2 (Selaelo Mphahele) wicket-takers (combined T20 + List A) in the 13/14 season?
questions.explanation: Michelle du Preez: 29 — Selaelo Mphahele: 27 — a gap of 2.

questions.question: At which ground did Knights record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — highest total of 427, against Kei on 2018/11/24.

questions.question: At Kimberley Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (List A)?
St George's Park hosted South Africa Women's first-ever Test in December 1960. How many years passed before it hosted its first women's ODI?
questions.explanation: St George's Park didn't host a Women's ODI until South Africa played Ireland there in December 2025, 65 years later, making it the last of South Africa's major Test venues to do so.
